name: pirc
description: Private, forward-authenticated web client for persistent coding-agent sessions

scripts.build: bun run --filter @pirc/web build && bun run --filter @pirc/gateway build
scripts.check: bun run version:check && bun run catalog:check && bun run browser-assets:check && bun run format:check && bun run check:rust && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run test:compiled && bun run test:conformance && bun run test:conformance:rust-gateway && bun run test:conformance:rust-agent && bun run test:conformance:rust-node
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && env -u PIRC_CONFORMANCE_BIN_DIR -u PIRC_CONFORMANCE_REQUIRED cargo test --workspace
scripts.test:conformance:rust-gateway: cargo build -p pirc-gateway && PIRC_CONFORMANCE_REQUIRED=1 PIRC_CONFORMANCE_BIN_DIR=apps/gateway/dist PIRC_CONFORMANCE_GATEWAY_BIN=target/debug/pirc-gateway INSTA_UPDATE=no cargo test -p pirc-conformance
scripts.test:conformance:rust-agent: cargo build -p pirc-node && PIRC_CONFORMANCE_REQUIRED=1 PIRC_CONFORMANCE_BIN_DIR=apps/gateway/dist PIRC_CONFORMANCE_AGENT_BIN=target/debug/pirc-node INSTA_UPDATE=no cargo test -p pirc-conformance --test 'agent_*' --test session
scripts.test:conformance:rust-node: cargo build -p pirc-gateway -p pirc-node && PIRC_CONFORMANCE_REQUIRED=1 PIRC_CONFORMANCE_BIN_DIR=apps/gateway/dist PIRC_CONFORMANCE_GATEWAY_BIN=target/debug/pirc-gateway PIRC_CONFORMANCE_NODE_BIN=target/debug/pirc-node PIRC_CONFORMANCE_AGENT_BIN=target/debug/pirc-node INSTA_UPDATE=no cargo test -p pirc-conformance
